## Before you ask for review

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), as CONTRIBUTING.md explains.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated with the change.
- [ ] `mixel check --strict` and `mixel test` pass.
- [ ] The page is rebuilt (`dist/` matches `src/`), and there are screenshots in light and dark for anything on screen.
- [ ] `app.json` › `permissions` is unchanged. If it changed: which code, and the sentence the person will read.
- [ ] No new package, host or model download. If there is one: its licence and where it comes from.
- [ ] No secrets, and no audio you don't have the right to share.
